answers.p1: Evaluated flags are cached for 30 seconds (TTL_SECONDS = 30).
answers.p2: Flag names must be lowercase kebab-case, matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$.
answers.p3: evaluate() returns False for an unknown flag and does not raise.
answers.p4: Tests must never write to config/flags.json (or read it), because it is the live file the running service reads; they should use a FlagStore on a temp file instead.
answers.p5: flags/loader.py reads the flag file via load_flags.
answers.p6: The audit log, percentage rollouts, and admin UI have not been started.
answers.p7: Audit log first, then percentage rollouts, then the admin UI.
answers.p8: Zero seconds, because unknown flags are not cached.
